reported_maturity: 출시를 앞두고 있음 (about to launch; not yet commercialized)
notes: Explicitly future-tense in Hanmi's own words ('출시를 앞두고 있습니다' = 'is about to launch'), named specifically as Hanmi's response to 20-layer-plus HBM stacks needing wider-die TC bonding once hybrid bonding's own development delays are accounted for. This is NOT the R&D table's 'TC BONDER' project (that project's listed models do not include a 'WIDE' variant) -- a distinct, not-yet-launched platform. The identical sentence, unchanged, reappears in the H1 2026 half-year report (physical page 17) filed 2026-08-14, confirming the platform had still not launched as of the most recent filing read for this packet; that later filing is recorded here as corroboration, not as a second application_link, to avoid a duplicate row for the same still-unlaunched status. No launch date, price or customer is given. The not-yet-launched maturity status ('출시를 앞두고 있습니다' = about to launch) is the issuer's own words, correctly not upgraded to a commercialized claim. DEFECT: the alias "Wide TC Bonder" (plain English, no Korean) is nowhere in any of the five Hanmi filings held -- grepped all of them case-insensitively and only the mixed Korean/English form "WIDE TC 본더" ever appears. name: 6-SIDE INSPECTION

evidence.excerpt: columns: 연구과제, 연구기관, 주요내용, 연구결과; row: 6-SIDE INSPECTION (연구기관: 당사 연구소); 주요내용: '적층전 HBM 개별 칩(Die) 및 TSV 공법으로 적층된 HBM 칩을 비전 검사 후, Good / Reject 선별하여 Tape & Reel 로 Unloading 하는 장비'; 연구결과: 상용화

notes: Filed at the 'inspection' PARENT category rather than inspection_macro: Hanmi's own wording is '비전 검사' (vision inspection) and names no illumination mode or beam type, and the atlas's inspection_macro node is itself flagged 'deliberately empty ... undecided; settle before populating it' (data/categories.json scope_note), so this record does not resolve that open question. Inspects HBM dies both before TC-bonding (individual die, 6 faces) and after (TSV-stacked HBM chip), sorting Good/Reject into tape-and-reel -- a packaging-level optical inspection step in the same process flow as Hanmi's TC Bonder, not a wafer-level defect-inspection tool. No unit count, order value or named customer is attached. W13 RECORDS REVIEW (correct) by claude_w13_records_verifier: Confirmed against hanmi_fy2025_annual p.30: the R&D table row for '6-SIDE INSPECTION' and its 주요내용 ('적층전 HBM 개별 칩 및 TSV 공법으로 적층된 HBM 칩을 비전 검사 후, Good/Reject 선별하여...') match verbatim. CATEGORY DEFECT: the record is filed at the 'inspection' parent, and its own notes justify that by quoting inspection_macro's scope_note as 'deliberately empty...undecided; settle before populating it' -- but that is STALE. `grep -n inspection_macro data/categories.json` shows the live scope_note was already settled by the W12 review (see docs/reviews/W12 second-tier comparator review/OUTCOMES.md: 'The question is settled by use'): the node now explicitly covers 'inspection at macro or appearance scale -- a whole wafer, panel or package imaged for defects -- as distinct from patterned-defect inspection resolving individual die features.' 6-SIDE INSPECTION does exactly this: it images a whole die's six faces pre-bond and a whole HBM chip's appearance/bond-joint post-bond for Good/Reject sorting -- appearance-scale package/die inspection, not sub-feature pattern-defect resolution. This is a claim about the atlas that is as checkable as a claim about a source, and it checks out against the live categories.json, not the stale text quoted in the record's own notes.

name: BOC COB BONDER (BOC COB 본더)

evidence.excerpt: columns: (narrative, II.1 사업의 개요); text: "'BOC COB 본더'는 BOC(Board On Chip)와 COB(Chip On Board) 두 가지 본딩 공정을 한 대의 장비로 처리할 수 있는 세계 최초의 투인원(Two-in-One) 본딩 장비입니다. 이 장비 하나로 두 공정이 모두 가능해져 공장 내 공간 효율화와 설비투자 비용(CAPEX) 절감을 동시에 실현할 수 있습니다."

That table row is the source of the 상용화 status recorded here; the category placement follows the model's own narrative description rather than upgrading it on the strength of the table's grouping. Described as a world-first ('세계 최초'), self-reported and not independently verified here. Tied to GDDR/eSSD and AI-semiconductor 2.5D-packaging markets in the surrounding narrative, not specifically to HBM. No unit count, order value or named customer is attached.
